queries: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT timespan, order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts) SELECT timespan, order_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY timespan;

WITH time_in_force(timespan) AS (VALUES ('IOC'), ('GTC'), ('GTD'), ('FOK')), counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT t.timespan, COALESCE(c.order_count, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(c.order_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(c.order_count, 0)) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM time_in_force AS t LEFT JOIN counts AS c ON c.timespan = t.timespan) SELECT timespan, order_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY timespan;
